@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：照片邊緣或反光處，個別字詞可能有誤。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tim a______ed that he had made a huge mistake by lying to his parents about his grades.
= acknowledged
~詞義 acknowledge（v.）承認
~原文 Tim acknowledged that he had made a huge mistake by lying to his parents about his grades.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The statue of Cupid looks like a c______y baby boy with a pair of wings.
= chubby
~詞義 chubby（adj.）圓胖的
~原文 The statue of Cupid looks like a chubby baby boy with a pair of wings.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After Alex was injured in the accident, he lost all s______ns in his limbs and thus couldn't feel a bite on his arm.
= sensations
~詞義 sensation（n.）知覺
~原文 After Alex was injured in the accident, he lost all sensations in his limbs and thus couldn't feel a bite on his arm.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The famous director's latest film is widely considered to be a m______e. It has won the praise of both critics and the public.
= masterpiece
~詞義 masterpiece（n.）傑作
~原文 The famous director's latest film is widely considered to be a masterpiece. It has won the praise of both critics and the public.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our school's football team worked very hard to q______y for the district finals. We're all very proud that they made it.
= qualify
~詞義 qualify（v.）具有資格
~原文 Our school's football team worked very hard to qualify for the district finals. We're all very proud that they made it.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The new software program is ______ with the old laptops, so the school has to upgrade its equipment.
A: biological
B: incompatible
C: parallel
D: sacred
= B
~詞義 incompatible（adj.）不相容的
~原文 The new software program is incompatible with the old laptops, so the school has to upgrade its equipment.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Linda finds herself in a ______: She can't decide whether to go to her friend's birthday party or the concert.
A: circuit
B: dilemma
C: patrol
D: variation
= B
~詞義 dilemma（n.）進退兩難
~原文 Linda finds herself in a dilemma: She can't decide whether to go to her friend's birthday party or the concert.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The athlete ______ a minor injury during practice but recovered quickly after resting for a few days.
A: diminished
B: sustained
C: evolved
D: tackled
= B
~詞義 sustain（v.）蒙受(損害等)
~原文 The athlete sustained a minor injury during practice but recovered quickly after resting for a few days.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Ted is ______ about tennis. Whenever he has free time, he watches live tennis games or reads reviews of his favorite players.
A: descriptive
B: legitimate
C: passionate
D: sustainable
= C
~詞義 passionate（adj.）熱情的
~原文 Ted is passionate about tennis. Whenever he has free time, he watches live tennis games or reads reviews of his favorite players.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mining crew stepped away as the rock wall was ______ open, and a narrow tunnel hidden behind it was revealed.
A: attributed
B: adored
C: blasted
D: terrified
= C
~詞義 blast（v.）炸開
~原文 The mining crew stepped away as the rock wall was blasted open, and a narrow tunnel hidden behind it was revealed.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: partly
B: blur
C: comedian
D: obscure
E: saint
F: flexibility

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: What Penny told you is only ______ true. She did not tell you the entire story.
= A
~詞義 partly（adv.）部分地
~原文 What Penny told you is only partly true. She did not tell you the entire story.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The famous actor started as a standup ______. He was so funny that a director asked him to be in a film that turned out to be a huge success.
= C
~詞義 comedian（n.）喜劇演員
~原文 The famous actor started as a standup comedian. He was so funny that a director asked him to be in a film that turned out to be a huge success.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: I like to find nice little shops and restaurants in ______ corners of the city. That way, I can enjoy them all by myself.
= D
~詞義 obscure（adj.）無名的
~原文 I like to find nice little shops and restaurants in obscure corners of the city. That way, I can enjoy them all by myself.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mike doesn't like to completely fill up his schedule; instead, he likes to maintain some ______.
= F
~詞義 flexibility（n.）彈性
~原文 Mike doesn't like to completely fill up his schedule; instead, he likes to maintain some flexibility.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The child kept moving while we were taking the photo, so he was just a(n) ______ in the picture.
= B
~詞義 blur（n.）模糊形狀
~原文 The child kept moving while we were taking the photo, so he was just a(n) blur in the picture.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: salon
B: immune
C: commodity
D: destructive
E: ragged
F: radical

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The computer chip is an important ______ in the international market. It is an essential part of many products.
= C
~詞義 commodity（n.）商品
~原文 The computer chip is an important commodity in the international market. It is an essential part of many products.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Nuclear energy can provide power for people's everyday lives, but it can also be used in ______ weapons.
= D
~詞義 destructive（adj.）破壞性的
~原文 Nuclear energy can provide power for people's everyday lives, but it can also be used in destructive weapons.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is not easy to discuss politics with people who hold ______ views. They seldom accept others' opinions rationally.
= F
~詞義 radical（adj.）激進的
~原文 It is not easy to discuss politics with people who hold radical views. They seldom accept others' opinions rationally.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Doctors recommend certain vaccines to strengthen the ______ system against dangerous diseases.
= B
~詞義 immune（adj.）免疫的
~原文 Doctors recommend certain vaccines to strengthen the immune system against dangerous diseases.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: David has been wearing that shirt for more than ten years; it is now in a(n) ______ condition.
= E
~詞義 ragged（adj.）破爛的
~原文 David has been wearing that shirt for more than ten years; it is now in a(n) ragged condition.
